description: Election Commission - Filling of a vacancy in the office of the member of the Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha.
reasoning: The gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local government body (Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process triggered by a resignation and the subsequent nomination and declaration of a new elected member by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under electoral processes at the local authority level, making it an **Elections Gazette**.
